response.sql: WITH transaction_data AS (SELECT COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, 'MISSING') AS ordertypedist FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg),grouped_data AS (SELECT ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS count FROM transaction_data GROUP BY ordertypedist),stats AS (SELECT SUM(count) AS total_count, COUNT(*) AS num_mixes FROM grouped_data) SELECT gd.ordertypedist AS mix, gd.count, CAST(gd.count AS REAL) / s.total_count AS share, CAST(gd.count AS REAL) / s.total_count - 1.0 / s.num_mixes AS above_average FROM grouped_data gd, stats s WHERE CAST(gd.count AS REAL) / s.total_count > 1.0 / s.num_mixes ORDER BY CAST(gd.count AS REAL) / s.total_count DESC
